steps.text: a lesson: the instrument, and what to do
press rec. four clicks count you in
tap the open hat on every "and"
four of four: your hats are in
kept. now shape it
decay makes each hat short or long
the screen draws what the knob is doing
five minutes a day, picked from your lessons
each drill trains one thing your ears need
open copy by ear
listen to the target, then write it down
tap the steps you heard
check: it marks every note right or off
the studio: your song on real instruments
play the pads
turn a knob and watch the sound change
press play
arrange: your loop as sections
switch a part on or off in each section
to live sends your song to Ableton Live
two decks and a mixer, like a real controller
play deck a: your song
play deck b
slide the crossfader from a to b
turn down the bass on deck a
match deck b's tempo
or press sync
and mix back
every device in Live, in one place
search by name, or by what you want to hear
more space: the devices that do it
each device opens on a loop
press play
turn a knob: the screen says what it does
a and b: hear it without, then with
